purpose: Original illustrative demo assets for Storybook and image-component documentation; not a photograph of a real PEK facility.
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: one original demonstration photograph for a responsive HTML picture component in a local Storybook and its documentation for a Russian logistics website.
Primary request: create one polished, believable wide landscape image of a modern logistics terminal, with a clean unbranded red-and-white delivery truck beside a contemporary light-gray warehouse and neatly organized loading bays. Calm professional editorial photography, restrained colors and soft natural morning daylight. A few plain cardboard parcels on a pallet may appear naturally near the loading area.
Composition: a single cohesive scene in landscape 3:2 aspect ratio, requested output resolution 3072 by 2048 pixels. Whole truck visible, balanced architectural composition, useful detail from foreground to background, no dramatic perspective distortion. The same complete frame will be displayed at small and large sizes; keep key subjects easy to recognize at mobile widths.
Materials: realistic vehicle proportions, corrugated metal cladding, subtle asphalt texture and physically plausible shadows.
Constraints: fictional location, no real brand, no company lettering, no signs or readable writing, no watermark, no interface, no border, no collage, no inset image, no people, no transparent background. This is an illustrative demo asset, not evidence of an actual company facility.
alt: Красный грузовой автомобиль с белым кузовом у погрузочных ворот современного склада.

processing.note: All AVIF and WebP candidates were produced directly from the original generated PNG. That source file is not stored in this project; its dimensions, size and SHA-256 are retained as provenance only. The requested 3072x2048 output was returned as 1536x1024; no artificial enlargement was performed.
